evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Amy opens with 'I just wanted to touch base with you gather some details to make sure that we provided an after estimate' — no time-boxed framing, no 'does that sound good to you' wait.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Amy: 'You aside from the price, is there any specific concern or like what are you most worried about for this upcoming move?' — asked AFTER she had already confirmed the move date, apartment details, inventory, and was deep into probing.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Adrian says 'I think price is the biggest one' and Amy responds 'Price get. Well, no worries. I'll explain the pricing in a bit' — concern acknowledged but no follow-up like 'tell me more about that,' conversation pivots immediately to boxes.
evidence_quotes.active_listening_reflection: No summary reflection of concerns. Amy never says 'So what I'm hearing is...' or confirms she understands Adrian's concerns.
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Amy: 'September 30th Wednesday is actually one of our cheapest rate Monday to Thursday the same price which is $208 per hour with two movers already just like forwards an all inclusive about late... two and a half hour minimum if we go beyond 220 half hours we will prorate the time in every fifteen minute increments.' Typical range and fee transparency both present.
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: Amy discloses trip fee / no credit card fees, no terrible fees, no disassemble or reassembly fees, 2.5-hour minimum, 15-minute increments — all fee transparency and commitment framing present.
evidence_quotes.feels_fair_then_silence: Amy never asks 'Does that feel fair?' or any version of it. She moves directly into clarifying questions and alternative options.
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee: Not mentioned at all in the call.
evidence_quotes.damage_coverage: Not mentioned at all in the call.
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: Call ends with Amy offering to email the estimate and asking Adrian to call back with a decision: 'I will email you this estimate the two day estimate if you think that would be a better option. Just call me back at this number once you're decided.' No direct 'Would you like our help with your move?' ask.
evidence_quotes.booking_confirmed: Amy confirms date (Sept 30), time window (8:30-9am, or flexible for two-day option), crew size (2 movers), addresses (415 Colorado / 11901 Burnett), but does NOT confirm phone number or notes for crew about Adrian's concerns (traffic/timing). Adrian explicitly leaves the decision open ('Is it okay if I make that decision after tomorrow?') so no commitment is made.

top_strength: Amy systematically gathered all discovery basics (name, date, route, apartment details, inventory changes, special items like the new TV) and confidently explained hourly pricing with full transparency on fees, minimums, and time increments.
coaching_note: Open with the quid-pro-quo framing (10–15 minutes, you'll walk away with a quote you can depend on, does that sound good?) before probing; ask about concerns FIRST, then go two layers deep on each one; close every estimate with 'Does that feel fair?' and wait; deliver both Two Promises (On-Time Guarantee and No Worries Damage Coverage) before asking for the business; and end with a direct 'Would you like our help with your move?' — never leave the customer to call back with a decision.
